# eduLIMS

> eduLIMS is an open-source laboratory information management system (LIMS) for practical laboratory education. Students register samples, upload Gen5 Excel exports from the Epoch 2 plate readers, check their measurements and submit a lab report; teachers set up practicals, grade with a rubric and follow a KPI dashboard; an administrator manages users, classes and analysers. Measurement data is stored as openEHR compositions in FerroEHR (Afinion 2 results arrive over HL7 v2 through FerroBRIDGE); teaching data and grades live in the eduLIMS PostgreSQL database. It is a TanStack Start (full SSR) application on Vite and Nitro, written in TypeScript 7, with sign-in through Microsoft Entra ID or Keycloak and an English UI with a Dutch translation. eduLIMS ships no AI; AI coding assistance is used to build it, under human review.

## Start here

- [Documentation site](https://edulims.eu/docs/): the published documentation; the landing page is <https://edulims.eu>.
- [README](README.md): what eduLIMS is, the status, the quick start and the stack.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): the design authority: principles, integrations, data split, portals and roles, deployment, quality requirements.
- [Requirements](docs/requirements.md) (working draft, not final): S1 to S9, D1 to D8, B1 to B4, the Q-* quality requirements, risks R-01 to R-10 and the KPIs, with stable IDs.
- [Working rules](CLAUDE.md): the rules for changing the code.
